name: How long does custom cabinetry take in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline from design approval to installation for custom cabinets and finishes in a luxury remodel?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical timeline from design approval to installation for custom cabinets and finishes in a luxury remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry timelines vary widely, but most projects move through design, shop drawings, fabrication, finishing, and installation. Small built-in projects can sometimes be completed faster than full kitchens or whole-home millwork, especially if the design is straightforward and finishes are standard. Complex finishes, specialty veneers, inset detailing, appliance panels, and custom hardware can add time. In Los Angeles remodels, the schedule also depends on whether the site is ready for measurement, whether other trades are complete, and whether finish samples are approved quickly. A realistic schedule should include time for revisions and curing, not just fabrication. To avoid delays, finalize appliance specs early, confirm wall dimensions after rough work is complete, and approve samples before production starts. If the project is tied to a move-in date or countertop install, ask for a detailed sequence instead of a general lead time estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinetry projects often take several weeks to a few months from final approval to installation, depending on scope, material availability, finish complexity, and site readiness. Simple projects move faster than full kitchen or whole-home millwork packages. Delays usually come from design changes, slow sample approval, or unfinished construction on site.
